parsed.explanation: Severe risk: state-directed police raids and detention of queer people form a documented recurring pattern (2017 mass raids; 2023 party raid), including forced medical examinations, beatings, blackmail, sexual harassment and threats of outing or rape; at least 60 were imprisoned or fined; inadequate police response to trans murder; no legal protection and state media hostility. Lack of documented border or facility exposure and some external accountability slightly temper, but severe consequences upon police discovery dominate. All incidents are capital-based; absence outside the capital is undocumented, not safety.
